Cara must be in slot 5. Gus is immediately after Cara, Elif is at least three slots after Cara, and Ann, Hana and Ivo all come before Cara. That leaves only Cara in slot 4, 5 or 6. Slot 4 fails because Ivo would be too close to Gus. Slot 6 fails because Dev would have to sit on Gus's slot. So Cara is in slot 5, Gus in 6, Elif in 9 and Dev in 7.

The remaining people fill slots 1–4 and 8. Finn must be 8, since the only slot exactly two from Gus that is also at least three from Cara is 8. Ann and Ben must be 1 and 4, so Ann is 1 and Ben is 4. Ivo must be 3 to be two from Ann, which puts Hana in 2.

Checking all 16 constraints against this order gives no violations, and the case analysis shows it is the only valid schedule. This agrees with your earlier answer and with the team note's "Cara in slot 5, with Ben in slot 4."

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Ann","2":"Hana","3":"Ivo","4":"Ben","5":"Cara","6":"Gus","7":"Dev","8":"Finn","9":"Elif"}
CONFIDENCE: 99
